notes: Your own IX now supports extra router uplinks and the A/B/Both site controls. Uplinks use router ports, share the fabric capacity and keep working through a single-site outage when split across both sites (#36).
A PNI in the customer’s city now meets their local-breakout requirement while your network is Tier 1 (#20).
Retained the PNI directory, missing-POP deal navigation, installed-app HUD fix and on-demand link redundancy checks.

Tier 1 networks can lay their own subsea cable (#22). Pick two cities with a cable landing station, pay a frankly rude amount of money, wait while a cable ship crosses the ocean, and own up to eight fiber pairs outright. It pays for itself in a few years if it replaces enough leased waves. Whales may cause delays.
